findings.passage: “I just voted my heart and my constituents are likely not the gun groups,” Harless said.
findings.note: Quoted by the AP (via KSAT) after his committee vote on a bill to raise the purchase age for certain semiautomatic weapons from 18 to 21. Date is the article date. The same article quotes him: “Every kid has a right to go to school and feel safe, and every parent has a right for the kid to feel safe at school,” Harless said in an interview.
